defects.description: `p.stdout.split()` splits `git ls-files` output on all whitespace, which would fail to correctly parse filenames containing spaces. `p.stdout.splitlines()` is the standard and safer approach for this output.

`selftest_runtime_ledgers` silently skips the `check-refs.sh` integration test entirely if all runtime ledgers happen to exist on the local disk. This makes the test coverage environment-dependent; it could have used a temporary directory or mock to ensure the test always runs.
